Name: Asa, Father of Berechiah
Summary: Father of Berechiah the Levite, son of Elkanah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:16: Father of Berechiah the Levite, son of Elkanah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Asa in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
